passive.name: Staggering Blow
passive.description: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

spells.name: Dredge Line
spells.description: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing magic damage and Stunning them briefly. If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus will drag himself towards it.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation QDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Titan's Wrath
spells.description: Nautilus gains a Shield for seconds. While the Shield persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal an additional magic damage over 2 seconds to his target and all surrounding enemies.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DotDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.description: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself, each dealing magic damage to enemies in the area and Slows them by % decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.description: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing magic damage, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also Knocked Up and Stunned and take magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PrimaryTargetDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
